Regeneration: HP, Mana and stamina recover faster.
Aggressor: started a fight with a player. Fighting back costs no honor.
Dishonored: honor below zero. Killing them earns honor.
Thief: stole something recently. Killing them earns extra honor.
Stunned: you cannot move, attack, cast or use items.
Frozen: you cannot act. You count as Water and break free on the next hit.
Stoning: you are turning to stone. A cure now stops it.
Stone: you cannot act, count as Earth and take much less damage.
Immobilized: you cannot move, but you can still fight.
Confused: you walk the wrong way.
Feared: you run away and cannot attack or cast. Potions still work.
Blind: you see little and hit less often.
Poisoned: you lose health over time and do not regenerate. It never takes your last hit point.
Bleeding: walking, attacking and casting cost health. Stand still or heal to stop it.
Burning: you take fire damage every second. Water or ice put it out.
Withered: less health and vitality, slower healing.
Regenerating: you heal every few seconds.
Lifesteal: your blows heal you by half the damage they deal.
Mana sealed: your mana does not come back on its own.
Enraged: you hit harder and take less damage. Fatigue follows.
Fatigued: you are weaker for a moment.
Berserk: much stronger and quicker, but your armor guards nothing.
Tailwind: you move and attack quicker.
Endowed weapon: your plain blows hit with an element.
Elemental coat: hits on you count against another element.
Off balance: you hit less often.
Quagmire: you are clumsy and slow while you stand in the mire.
Sheltered: shots and arrows miss you.
Mirror veil: single-target skills turn back on their caster.
Barrier: it soaks up the next blows.
Corrosive: weapons that hit you wear down.
Hidden: other players cannot see you. You cannot move. Acting reveals you.
Cloaked: other players cannot see you. You move slower. Acting or being hit reveals you.
Armor stripped: you cannot put armor on until this ends.
Disarmed: you cannot take up a weapon until this ends.
Struck off: missed a mail deadline. No post work until this ends.
